pr.title: Retry failed uploads with backoff
pr.description:
Uploads to the storage service fail now and then with a 503 when it is busy. Until now one failure lost the whole upload and the user had to start again.

This PR retries an upload up to five times, waiting longer after each failure (exponential backoff with jitter), and gives up at once on errors a retry cannot fix, such as 400 and 403. The wait respects a Retry-After header when the server sends one. Cancelling the upload stops the waiting too.

Testing: unit tests cover the retry counts and waits with a fake clock. I also ran it against a staging bucket with fault injection at 30%; every upload of 200 finished.
